assumptions.reason: Time-based windowing is the most common aggregation trigger.
Event time produces accurate billing windows regardless of processing delays.
Hourly aggregation is the platform default window.
JS is the default scripting language; PYTHON is also supported.

blockers.message: SCRIPT_AGGREGATOR language is required. Which scripting language? ('JS' or 'PYTHON')
SCRIPT_AGGREGATOR source code is required. Provide the script that accumulates state and emits aggregated output.
SCRIPT_AGGREGATOR groupFields is required. Which fields define the aggregation groups? (e.g. ["accountNumber"])
SCRIPT_AGGREGATOR eventTimeField is required when timeoutType is EventTime. Which event field contains the timestamp?
SCRIPT_AGGREGATOR schemaId is required. Which output schema should the aggregated events conform to? (get the ID from the Schema Registry)
